messages:
olga: Starting RC creation for release 2026-03-20. Nightshift handoff @22:00 UTC. Intend to promote a single serial RC from build sha abc123def -> rc-2026-03-20-1. Plan: canary 5% (15m) -> 25% (30m) -> 100% (1h). Pin artifact during promo. Anyone object?

maya: +1 to the plan. Suggest add KV-warm step pre-5%: ` /deploy warm kv --keys=core,session`

deploy-bot: Build created: artifact: registry.redwood.ai/serve/release:abc123def
RC created: rc-2026-03-20-1
Canary policy: 5,25,100
Pin: enabled
Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/abc123def

raj: DB migration check: no schema migration, just index creation that runs online. I will monitor qps during 25% stage.

sophie: I can own post-promo smoke — will run quick evals + user-flow checklist. ping me when at 100%

olga: Adding emergency rollback criteria: 1) 5xx rate > 2% sustained for 5m, 2) p95 latency > 1.2s delta vs baseline, 3) critical evals fail (login/search). If triggered: immediate rollback to previous stable tag `stable-2026-03-15` and block further promos. Ops will call rollback.

ops-bot: Rollback command: `/deploy rollback rc-2026-03-20-1 --to stable-2026-03-15 --reason="auto-threshold"`. Deadman's switch: `/deploy abort-all`

aaron: Oncall acked. I'll be tracking error budget and will call timeout at 25% if anomalies start.

olga: Running pre-promo checklist:
- traffic shadow run: done
- KV warm job: queued
- smoke suite: green
- release notes published: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-20
- change window: 22:00-02:00 UTC
Requesting signoff from eng-sre and release lead.

maya: signoff from SRE: +1 (maya)

raj: signoff db: +1 (raj)

sophie: signoff QA/smoke: +1 (sophie)

deploy-bot: `/deploy promote rc-2026-03-20-1 --pin --canary-policy=5,25,100 --notify=#prod-alerts`
promotion started by olga

deploy-bot: Canary 5% started. KV warm job running. Observability endpoint: https://telemetry.redwood.ai/dash/rc-2026-03-20-1
ETA next step: 15m

maya: Observability looks fine at 5% (p95 +20ms). No error spikes.

deploy-bot: Canary 5% hold complete. Proceeding to 25% per schedule.

deploy-bot: Canary 25% started after hold.

aar on: I'm seeing a small spike in auth latencies at 25% — 0.3s increase p95. Not yet alarming but keeping eyes.

olga: Sophie run the login smoke again.

sophie: login smoke ok, search eval shows 0.4% regression in rerank quality but within tolerance.

aar on: Error rate still <0.3%, p95 within threshold. Recommend proceed to 100% in 30m if stable. I'll keep watch.

olga: Proceeding to 100% in 25m.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% initiated. Pin remains enabled. Post-promo runway: 1h of elevated monitoring.

ops-bot: Reminder: if we need fast fallback, route policy can flip to stable-prod in <2m via infra-toggle.

sophie: post-promo smoke green. All critical flows nominal. Marking release as promoted.

olga: Thanks all. Documenting action items: follow up with performance regression ticket for rerank quality (low priority). Nightshift handoff: aaron owns 22:00-02:00 UTC checks. Closing thread.
